description: Search eligible retail merchants in the selected Bestshopping account market by name, domain or ID. Results exclude adult shops, restricted categories, digital vouchers, top-ups and services. Reads Bestshopping catalog data only; does not browse merchant websites or activate tracking. Cashback is reserved for eligible account holders aged 18 or over.

market.description: Bestshopping ACCOUNT market: it (Italy), de (Germany), fr (France). Ask the user if missing or ambiguous; never infer it from language or reuse IDs across markets.

query.description: Merchant name, website domain or ID. Empty string lists the catalog.

name: search_merchants
